name: COVID-19 - Businesses Requiring Proof of Vaccination - Historical

Metadata.Data Owner: Department of Business Affairs and Consumer Protection

columns.name: ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for the business. This ID does not match any other dataset.

columns.name: INDUSTRY
columns.description: The industry in which the business operates.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: The location of the business in a format that allows for mapping and other geographic analysis on this data portal.

columns.name: Community Areas
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Community Areas' (vrxf-vc4k) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
